protocol.decision: After the fifth booking decision and before the sixth signed price, choose buy or skip. One purchase costs one net credit. Buying reveals the count of high readings in six conditionally independent samples taken at the current wave-six market rate. Both competitors see the same potential reading, freight draws, prices, stale bulletins and fee. Buyers retain the reading through wave eight.
protocol.fitting: Each independent 12,000-seed block supplies disjoint draws for 84,000 later booking training shifts, 84,000 purchase and early booking training shifts and 15,000 training-only selection shifts. Selection and fitting use disjoint training openings. The exact original drop and all public evaluation schedules are excluded.
protocol.selection: Prespecify ten training profiles, equal per shift or hot-drop mass {1,4,12} crossed with recovery mass {1,4,12}, holding cold reversals at 4 and other paired endings together at 1. Maximize minimum training-only goal slack, then mean slack, then fixed profile order. Release seed 13 regardless of outcome.
protocol.planner: Distribution-aware planner with the same priced survey. Condition on observed offers, noisy delayed bulletins and purchased readings using only training-market priors and known simulator emissions. Charge before comparing purchase and skip. Also score the unchanged legacy distribution-aware planner.
protocol.hotDrops: Fresh hot-ending interrupted drops require the lower paired 95% bound for net agent minus optional paid planner to exceed zero.
protocol.coldReversals: Cold-ending reversals require a positive lower bound versus the optional paid planner and a lower bound above minus one credit against both Booking and Survey. Apply separately on new schedules, earlier Booking patterns and earlier Survey patterns, each on fresh draws.
protocol.originalDrop: On new draws of the exact original interrupted drop require positive lower bounds against the optional paid planner, previous Booking, Survey and the original stochastic planner. Require lower bounds above minus one credit against each of Rally, Trust, Drift and Turns.
protocol.controls: At the same one-credit tariff force buy or skip at the purchase gate for each policy. Also replay each optional policy at zero price, with the fee change visible to it. Free comparisons are counterfactuals. For the learned purchase rule, separately report whether optional performance exceeds each forced choice on all fresh shifts by a positive paired lower bound.
protocol.diagnosis: At each optional policy's reached acquisition state, fork the same tape and force buy or skip, then follow that policy on the remaining freight decisions. Report purchase counts, fees, gross and net, realized net value by buy and skip group, and how often the survey changes a subsequent freight action. Counterfactual returns are scored only after decisions.
protocol.joint: Require fresh hot superiority, original recovery and cold preservation on fresh, Booking and Survey banks. No model reselection after evaluating the public splits.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired percentile intervals resample whole seeds 2,000 times and keep sibling endings together. Inference is conditional on fixed schedules and the designated release agent.
